title: Best k-Day Stretch
statementMd:
A shop records daily sales. Find the **largest total over any k consecutive days**. Use a **sliding window**: add the day entering the window and subtract the day leaving it — O(n), not O(n·k).

**Input**
Line 1: `n k` (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 10⁵). Line 2: n integers (may be negative).

**Output**
The maximum sum of k consecutive values.
hints: Sum the first k values — that is the first window.
Slide: window += a[i] - a[i - k] for i from k to n - 1, tracking the best.
